# Route inventory (generated by `node scripts/routeInventory.js --markdown`)

678 route registrations in 46 router files. Static scan: guards are read from the registration line, so treat it as a review aid.

Columns: **auth** = `authenticate` in front; **role** = a role or permission guard; **inst** = an institute guard in the router (the handler may scope as well); **limit** = a rate limiter.
